title: intent: remove legacy ImproverQualityReport
description: Delete the ImproverQualityReport type and all its usages. Replace with the unified domain::QualityReport.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL have zero redundant quality types.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL verify zero references to legacy report types.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT be considered clean

invariants: All suggestions are still correctly mapped to issues

title: intent: refactor BeadTemplates to use domain Spec
description: Update the bead generation engine to consume the unified domain::Spec type instead of ad-hoc internal types.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL generate work items from the unified specification model.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL map Spec behaviors to BeadRecords.

unwanted.condition: IF the spec contains invalid characters
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT produce malformed JSONL

invariants: The number of beads matches the number of behaviors + features

phase_0: Map domain types to bead fields

title: intent: refactor Resolver to use domain Spec
description: Update the dependency resolver to build its graph from the domain::Spec model.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL resolve work dependencies based on the specification graph.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL verify the DAG of the domain::Spec.

unwanted.condition: IF a cycle is detected in the spec
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow plan generation

postconditions: Resolver::resolve returns a sorted execution plan

title: intent: standardize SessionId newtype
description: Implement a SessionId(String) newtype in domain/types.rs and use it throughout the intent module.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL use a distinct type for session identification.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL wrap the ID in the SessionId type.

unwanted.condition: IF a raw string is passed as an ID
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow the call to compile

invariants: SessionId is always serializable to a string

title: intent: migration for old JSONL records
description: Implement a migration layer to load legacy intent-cli JSONL records into the new unified domain types.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL maintain backwards compatibility with existing project data.

event_driven.trigger: WHEN an old record is loaded
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL perform a lossless upgrade to the domain schema.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT corrupt the database
unwanted.because: user data safety is a priority.

postconditions: Old data maps correctly to DiscoverySession
